name: NM-2201
summary: NM-2201 (also known as CBL-2201 and NA-5F-PIC) is an indole-based synthetic cannabinoid that presumably has similar properties to the closely related 5F-PB-22 and NNE1, which are both full agonists and unselectively bind to CB1 and CB2 receptors with low nanomolar affinity.

pharmacology.text: NM-2201 acts as a full agonist with a binding affinity of 0.332 nM at CB1 and 0.732 nM at CB2 cannabinoid receptors. It has been linked to serious adverse events in users.

uses.text: NM-2201 was linked to an incident in December 2015 where 25-30 people in Ocala, FL were taken to hospitals after experiencing seizures.

sideEffects.en: Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, severe anxiety, paranoia and psychosis, and have been linked to seizures, kidney injury and deaths. They are often far stronger than cannabis. It was linked to a cluster of hospital admissions in Florida in December 2015.
sideEffects.zh: 它所屬的合成大麻素類藥物，可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、嚴重焦慮、妄想與精神病症狀，並與癲癇發作、腎損傷和死亡有關。這類藥物往往比大麻強得多。它與 2015 年 12 月佛羅里達州一批送醫事件有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它所属的合成大麻素类药物，可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、严重焦虑、妄想与精神病症状，并与癫痫发作、肾损伤和死亡有关。这类药物往往比大麻强得多。它与 2015 年 12 月佛罗里达州一批送医事件有关。

fact.en: Many synthetic cannabinoids carry a fluorine atom at the end of their tail, as this one does. Chemists add it partly to sidestep laws written around the unfluorinated version.
fact.zh: 許多合成大麻素的尾端都帶有一個氟原子，這個化合物也是如此。化學家加上氟的部分原因，是為了規避針對無氟版本所訂的法規。
fact.zhHans: 许多合成大麻素的尾端都带有一个氟原子，这个化合物也是如此。化学家加上氟的部分原因，是为了规避针对无氟版本所订的法规。
